info.title: cashbook
info.description: Keep the cashbook of your shop or association

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.summary: Create a new cashbook for the current user

name.description: The name of the cashbook (1 to 255 characters)

currency.description: The currency of the cashbook (ISO 4217 code)

account.description: The account the cashbook is kept for (up to 255 characters)

timezone.description: The timezone of the cashbook (IANA timezone ID, defaults to the timezone of the user)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: Invalid name, account, currency or timezone

401.description: Current user is not logged in

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the cashbook

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

404.description: Cashbook not found or not owned by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the cashbook

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

404.description: Cashbook not found or not owned by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

put.summary: Change the name and account of a cashbook

name.description: The new name of the cashbook (1 to 255 characters)

account.description: The new account the cashbook is kept for (up to 255 characters)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the cashbook

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

404.description: Cashbook not found or not owned by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: Get a paginated list of entries of a cashbook

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the cashbook

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of entries to skip

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: The offset or limit is out of range

404.description: Cashbook not found or not owned by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.summary: Add an income or expense entry to a cashbook
post.description: The entry is booked after the last entry of the cashbook at the current time. Entries can not be changed afterwards, mistakes need to be corrected with a new entry. If the cashbook was changed since `lastSequence` was loaded, the entry is rejected with the current cashbook.

lastSequence.description: The sequence number of the last entry of the cashbook, 0 if it has no entries

reason.description: The reason of the entry, only income and expense reasons except adjusting entries are allowed

amount.description: The positive amount as decimal string (e.g. `"12.50"`), expenses are subtracted from the balance

tax.description: The tax rate included in the amount (e.g. `0.19` for 19%)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the cashbook

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

409.description: The last entry is not `lastSequence`, the current cashbook is returned

400.description: Invalid values or the expense exceeds the cash balance

404.description: Cashbook not found or not owned by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.summary: Reverse an income or expense entry of a cashbook
post.description: Adds an entry after the last entry of the cashbook that negates the amount of the reversed entry and keeps its reason and tax rate. The reversed entry stays unchanged. Day openings and closings and reversals can not be reversed, and every entry can only be reversed once. If the cashbook was changed since `lastSequence` was loaded, the reversal is rejected with the current cashbook.

lastSequence.description: The sequence number of the last entry of the cashbook

text.description: The reason for the reversal (1 to 1000 characters)

reference.description: The receipt number of the reversal (up to 127 characters)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the cashbook

parameters.name: entryId
parameters.description: The id of the entry to reverse

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

409.description: The last entry is not `lastSequence`, the current cashbook is returned

400.description: The entry can not be reversed, invalid values or the reversal exceeds the cash balance

404.description: Cashbook or entry not found or not owned by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

get.summary: Get all entries of a cashbook within a date range, prepared for printing
get.description: If the range starts or ends within an open day, the whole day is included. Dates without a time (`YYYY-MM-DD`) are the start of that day in the timezone of the cashbook.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the cashbook

parameters.name: begin
parameters.description: Start of the date range (ISO 8601 date or date time, inclusive)

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the date range (ISO 8601 date or date time, exclusive)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: Invalid date passed or the range contains too many entries

404.description: Cashbook not found or not owned by the current user

401.description: Current user is not logged in

post.summary: Import a cashbook from uploaded files
post.description: The files need to be uploaded as `files[<name>]` form data, the names depend on the import format. The `sumup-pos-pro-de` format expects the cashbook export as `files[cashbook]` and optionally the daily closing report as `files[report]`.

timezone.description: The timezone of the dates in the uploaded files and of the cashbook (IANA timezone ID, defaults to the timezone of the user)

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

400.description: No files uploaded, unsupported import format, invalid files or timezone

401.description: Current user is not logged in
